what: the family of relative periodic orbits through the shortest orbit of my T* = 33.745 orbit (T* 3.7495, rotation 2/9 turn, word 01 per relative period), traced with tools/family-follow.mjs in both directions from the refined start values of data/refined/T33.745.json (t divided by 9). curve = accepted steps from the end of the 'down' trace to the end of the 'up' trace, (u1, u2, lam, t) = start, Tstar and Lstar = scale free period and angular momentum of one relative period, turns = rotation angle of one relative period in turns (the sign of the tracer, the opposite of perpInfo), minDist = closest approach in the orbit, closure = rms mismatch after one relative period with the best rotation removed. pieces = the traces with their start and the reason they ended; a restart is the same start with 24 pieces of the multiple shooting from the last point of the previous piece. nus = the nontrivial rotation numbers (multiplier angle in turns) and moduli of one relative period from the relative monodromy matrix (src/relative.js, double precision), sorted by distance from 1 as the code returns them; used by tools/branch-point.mjs to find the members with nu = 1/n.
